component.name: Lantern for Hyprland
component.summary: Understand and configure Hyprland, and leave nothing behind

description.p: Lantern for Hyprland is a settings app for Hyprland that makes your desktop easier to see, read and use, and then gets out of the way.

ul.li: Accessibility first: larger text, higher contrast, colors corrected for color blindness, calmer animations and an easier cursor, across the whole desktop.
It never takes over: it installs nothing, runs nothing with sudo, shows every change as a diff before writing it, and undoes it in one click.
One look everywhere: a theme changes window borders, Waybar, the launcher, notifications and GTK apps together.
It shows what Hyprland is doing: every option with its documentation, every keybinding and where it is set, a live map of monitors and windows, and an event log.

description.p: What it writes is plain Hyprland, Waybar and GTK configuration, with nothing of its own, so your desktop works the same if you stop using it.
Lantern for Hyprland is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Hyprland project.
